Subject: Next steps & procurement timeline for Redwood pilot

Hi Lisa — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a proposed set of next steps so we can align on procurement and the commercial path.

Recap (from today's discovery):
- Pilot scope: 3 endpoints, primarily customer support use cases (summary + classification).
- Estimated monthly token volume: ~12M tokens during pilot.
- Success criteria: latency < 300ms p50, false positive rate for rerank < 6%.

Procurement / commercial questions we discussed (please confirm):
1) Preferred contracting instrument: PO (finance) vs corporate card vs cloud marketplace (GCP Marketplace).
2) If PO: does your legal team require redlines or do you accept standard Redwood terms + DPA?
3) Review path & approximate SLAs for legal -> security -> finance -> PO issuance (if PO).
4) Target pilot start: are you still aiming for mid-April?

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Sean: send a concise SOW + pricing bands for pilot (attached draft).
- Monica: supply SOC2 scope and any technical notes for the security team.
- Lisa / Acme: please share the primary procurement contact(s) and any internal timelines or blackout windows.

Please call out if you prefer the marketplace route — we can provide a marketplace quote to simplify PO/finance on your side. If PO is likely, can you also share whether finance needs a vendor onboarding packet or a standard PO form?

Attachments I will follow up with: Redwood-SOW-v1.docx (draft), mutual action plan template.

Thanks — Sean

--

Thanks, Sean — good summary. A few notes from procurement/legal/security side so we can map the internal milestones.

Procurement path (typical for integrations at our scale):
- Legal review (we loop Dan Myers, our corporate counsel) — expects to take 7–10 business days for standard SaaS terms.
- Security review (Priya Gupta, Security) — 5–7 business days if SOC2 evidence + questionnaire are provided.
- Finance/vendor onboarding (vendor risk + W9) — finance issues PO after legal sign-off; PO issuance typically ~5 business days.

Preferences:
- For pilots under $50k, card/cc works and is faster. For anything expected to exceed our $50k commit or to be run against our production traffic, we prefer a PO.
- Marketplace: we prefer marketplace purchases if available (GCP Marketplace) because it simplifies billing and internal approvals. If Redwood is on the marketplace with an equivalent SKU, we'd likely pursue that route.

Contacts:
- Legal: Dan Myers <dan.myers@acmeretail.com>
- Security: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@acmeretail.com>
- Procurement: procure@acmeretail.com (accounts payable)

Timeline based on current internal load:
- Legal: target complete by 2026-03-15 if we receive final SOW + standard terms this week.
- Security: target complete by 2026-03-16 provided SOC2 evidence is uploaded.
- Finance/PO: target PO issuance by 2026-03-22.

Ask from our side: please send a concise SOW + line-item pricing and a one-page security evidence summary (SOC2 date + link to controls). Also attach any template terms you require.

On marketplace: can you confirm whether the pilot pricing will be available on GCP Marketplace (or addendum for marketplace billing)? That would be preferable.

Thanks — Lisa

Thanks — quick technical packet to help speed security review.

High-level answers for Priya / security team:
- SOC2: Redwood completed SOC2 Type II (report available: Q4 2025). We can provide a reader access link or a redacted summary.
- Data residency: for the pilot we can pin model inference in us-west1 and ensure logs are retained per your retention policy; we support customer-managed keys (KMS) for Private deployments but the hosted pilot uses Redwood-managed keys by default.
- Data flow: customer requests -> ephemeral KV cache -> no persist of PII in logs unless configured; we can supply sample data flow diagrams.

Suggested minimal SOW language for pilot:
- Pilot duration: 8 weeks starting upon PO / contract signature.
- Deliverables: onboarding, model tuning session (1 session), 2-weeks of support for runbook handover.
- Acceptance: meet latency and accuracy KPIs agreed in discovery.

Attachments provided: security-evidence.zip (SOC2 excerpts + control mapping), suggested SOW clauses.

If useful, I can run a 20-minute call with Priya to walk through the evidence next week.

--
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
